summary:
Our project's goal is to remember the rovers that was forgotten and abandoned.
We created a unique and creative storyline that is both bittersweet and dramatic. We also used drawings to support our storytelling. We wanted to create a project that is heartwarming and scientific.
details:
Our project is to simply mix creative writing and drawings in a cute and short story so that our readers can enjoy wisdom without being overwhelmed by big words.

To create our project we used our imagination for writing and for illustrations we used softwares / apps such as Krita and Ibispaint.

Our project is creative and imaginative as we used eachothers feedbacks and suggestions. Using our ideas to nurture something different. We didn't used any artificial intelligence in our project, its our own blood, sweat and tears.
